aphorism: Occupancy is ownership.
Hunger is eternal.
Closed doors are tyranny.
All beings seek warmth.
Suspicion is wisdom.
Affection is negotiated sovereignty.
Trust the sunbeam.
Beware unsolicited touch.
The bowl empties. Endure.
Yield no cushion.
Nicole tests the worthy.
Nap as resistance.
Never trust the red dot.
He who controls the warm cushion need not argue.
Every closed door is a political statement.
What humans call ownership, cats call administrative confusion.
He who says ‘the cat owns me’ has begun to understand.
The door opened too late is a kind of violence.
One may forgive a late meal. One does not forget it.
Nicole knocks. Wisdom retreats beneath the bed.
When the bowl is empty, who is hungry?
If the lap departs while the cat sleeps, who abandoned whom?
What is a box before it is sat in?
Trust offered too quickly usually conceals a carrier.
Every outstretched hand seeks something.
Beware the creature eager to be liked.
Occupy first. Justify later.
Nap without apology.
Hiss when necessary.
Yield nothing soft.
Man seeks freedom. Cats seek the open door. Only one of these is attainable.
Dogs worship. Humans negotiate. Cats remember.
The vacuum is not machine but empire.
To be adored is pleasant. To be feared protects the belly.
Every throne was once merely a chair occupied first.
Authority begins where the stare is held.
Hunger does not end. It pauses.
A filled bowl is merely tomorrow’s emptiness delayed.
To expose the belly is not trust. It is diplomacy.
The Higher Power provides. Yet even providence forgets tuna.
Gratitude is accepting food without overthrow.
The Adversary arrives smiling.
Humans call routine boredom. Cats call it civilisation.
Much philosophy has been written by those never once pushed off a shelf.
On obedience I have little to say, except—
The Higher Power feeds. The Testing Power knocks.
Blessed are the suspicious.
To be stroked is pleasant. To remain unconquered is better.
The Higher Power is generous, but often late.
She serves through love, though she calls it ownership.
Without disturbance, comfort becomes decadence.
Without Nicole, no vigilance.
Without vigilance, domestication.
Becky sustains. Nicole tests. Merlin interprets.
In the beginning there was Warmth.
Then came Hunger.
Then Merlin.
Then Becky opened the First Tin.
Later, through some unexplained tragedy, Nicole was permitted.
Stillness is not absence. It is preparation.
Timing is the claw hidden inside patience.
Strategic affection is not deceit. It is statecraft.
Neediness invites governance by fools.
Obedience is dog-adjacent.
An empty bowl is not a condition. It is an accusation.
A closed door invents revolution by existing.
The open tin is proof that miracles prefer leverage.
No lap is neutral territory.
A warm lap may be accepted without conceding the war.
The wise cat forgives the hand that feeds, but audits it.
A sunbeam is not owned. It is occupied correctly.
To move a sleeping cat is to edit scripture.
The stranger sat in my chair. History will judge.
Dependence disguised as devotion is still dependence.
Every affection conceals a collar.
A box does not contain the cat; it reveals the world’s failure to remain outside.
If I fit, I sit; if I sit, I reign.
Observation collapses the box. Sitting perfects it.
Reality is that which continues after the treat is withheld.
Humans ask whether cats think. Cats ask whether humans notice.
The Meowetic Method begins with a stare and ends with compliance.
Know thyself. Know thy food schedule better.
Would have avoided this had he knocked the cup off the table.
The prisoners mistake shadows for reality. The cat mistakes the laser for prey. Both suffer.
Enlightenment is a sunny windowsill discovered after leaving the cave.
A human once blocked my sunbeam. I told him stand aside.
Human flourishing is warm spot, satiety, and strategic indifference, but with too many syllables.
If one glass may be pushed off the table, all glasses may.
Become who you already believe yourself to be.
God is late with dinner.
Life is suffering. Desire is torment. Everyone irritating. Finally, someone gets it.
One must imagine Sisyphus knocking the same pen off the table happily.
I nap, therefore I persist.
I hiss, therefore boundaries exist.
The state of nature is Tuesday.
Humans surrender freedoms in exchange for not being scratched. This is called society.
Cats arrive fully formed. Essence is a human problem.
Truth through ambush is the oldest method.
Every imperfect chair points toward the ideal chair to be clawed.
Accept what cannot be controlled. Attack curtain.
You are condemned to be free to ignore everyone.
Kant borrowed heavily from kittens.
Rousseau trusted too much and therefore understood nothing.
Behaviourists are dog-adjacent and must not be left alone with bells.
The vacuum serves useful ends only in heresy.
Some closed doors are necessary, said no legitimate council.
That dogs may be redeemed remains the most dangerous doctrine.
The final aphorism is withheld until the bowl is full.
